claims.claim: A 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute died after severe pneumonia of undetermined cause.
Roughly 200 contacts were initially quarantined; most have since been released.
Russian authorities say thousands of tests found no dangerous pathogen and no plague cases.
WHO has requested more information, including around reports of another employee with pneumonia.
ECDC: no reported secondary cases or evidence of sustained transmission.
